data.title: IGO Society House
data.about:
Embark on a journey to luxury and prestige at Society House in Downtown Dubai, meticulously crafted by IGO Developers. This exceptional 55-story tower stands as a symbol of opulence and ambition. Society House invites you to experience the height of urban living with a range of meticulously designed options, including studios, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments.

Explore a collection of 404 fully and semi-furnished units spans 49 floors, offering something for every discerning individual. Whether you prefer the intimacy of a micro unit or the spaciousness of a 3-bedroom corner residence, Society House caters to your desires. Elevate your lifestyle at Society House by IGO Developers today!

location_tile.title: Your Private Oasis in Downtown Dubai:
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
This vibrant district hosts some of Downtown Dubai's most renowned landmarks, including the iconic Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building. From a bustling business hub rich in culture to celebrated brands and dining, Downtown Dubai offers an all-encompassing experience. Situated just a stone's throw away from the city's primary business district, it's the perfect choice for those seeking the best of both worlds at Society House in Downtown Dubai

  • Dubai Mall 1.1km
  • Burj Park by Emaar 2.1km
  • International Schools Partnership Middle East 2.7km
  • Jumeirah Open Beach 6.9km
  • Airport Terminal 3, Dubai 17.2km
